test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"chancellary"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"chancellery". **(चांसलरी)

 
 
• **Example: **The **chancellery** issued a new directive regarding foreign policy.
 
 
 
• **"Chancellery" **refers to the office or department of a chancellor. (चांसलरी)
 
 
• **Example: **The **chancellery** is responsible for all official communications.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Granary **(अन्नागार): A storehouse for threshed grain.

 
 
• **Example:** The farmers stored their harvest in the** granary.**
 
 
 
• **Dictionary **(शब्दकोश ): A book or electronic resource that lists the words of a language and gives their meaning.
 
 
• **Example: **She used the **dictionary** to look up the meaning of the word.
 
 
 
• **Directory** (निर्देशिका): A book or collection of information or directions.
 
 
• **Example:** The company **directory** lists all the employees and their contact information.
 
 

339:Tdbd,

The correct answer is Option 1)</strong&
